ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, from left to right there are six square sheets of paper, and on each sheet there is a gray figure, whose shapes in order look like L, H, U, a staircase/polyline strip, T, and a plus sign. The perimeter of the gray figure should be regarded as the boundary line between gray and white, plus the edges where the gray part lies on the outer boundary of the square paper. Then reason: Regard each gray figure as the result of removing the white part from the whole square. If what is removed is a white rectangle at a corner, then the two lengths originally missing from the outer boundary of the square are exactly made up by the two newly appearing internal boundary segments, so the perimeter of the gray figure is the same as the perimeter of the original square. If what is removed is a white notch recessed from the middle of one side, then one segment of the original outer boundary is replaced by an internal boundary segment of the same length, and two additional side edges are added, so the perimeter will become larger. Judge one by one: The 1st L shape is formed by removing a rectangle at a corner, so the perimeter is the same; the 2nd H shape has notches recessed from the top and bottom sides, so the perimeter is different; the 3rd U shape has a notch recessed from the top side, so the perimeter is different; the 4th staircase/polyline shape is only equivalent to removing white parts at corners, so the perimeter is the same; the 5th T shape is equivalent to removing white rectangles at the two bottom corners, so the perimeter is the same; the 6th plus-sign shape is equivalent to removing white rectangles at four corners, so the perimeter is the same. Therefore, there are altogether 4 figures whose perimeters are the same as that of the square paper itself.

raw_record.question_text: Maria drew the following figures on square sheets of paper. How many of these figures have the same perimeter as the square sheet of paper itself?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: there are six square sheets arranged left to right, containing gray figures shaped like an L, an H, a U, a stair/zigzag band, a T, and a plus sign. Treat the perimeter of each gray figure as the boundary between gray and non-gray plus any gray edge on the outside of the square. Use a cutout comparison with the original square: for a white rectangular corner cutout, the outside edge removed from the square perimeter is exactly replaced by equal-length inside edges, so the gray perimeter stays the same as the square. For a white notch cut from only one side, the original outside segment is replaced by that segment plus two extra vertical side edges, so the gray perimeter becomes larger than the square. Apply this visually: the L figure is the square with one corner rectangle removed, so it matches; the H has top and bottom side-notches, so it does not; the U has a top side-notch, so it does not; the stair/zigzag figure has corner cutouts, so it matches; the T has two bottom corner cutouts, so it matches; the plus sign has four corner cutouts, so it matches. Count the matching figures: 4.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中从左到右有六张方形纸，每张纸上有一个灰色图形，形状依次像 L、H、U、阶梯/折线带、T、加号。灰色图形的周长应看作灰色与白色的分界线，加上灰色部分落在方形纸外边界上的边。

再推理：把每个灰色图形看成从整张正方形中去掉白色部分。如果去掉的是一个角上的白色矩形，那么原来正方形外边界少掉的两段长度，正好由新出现的内部两段边界补回，所以灰色图形周长与原正方形周长相同。如果去掉的是从一条边中间凹进去的白色缺口，则原外边界的一段被替换为同长的一段内边界，还额外多出两条侧边，所以周长会变大。

逐个判断：第1个 L 形是去掉一个角上的矩形，周长相同；第2个 H 形有从上、下边凹入的缺口，周长不同；第3个 U 形有从上边凹入的缺口，周长不同；第4个阶梯/折线形只相当于去掉角上的白色部分，周长相同；第5个 T 形相当于去掉两个底部角上的白色矩形，周长相同；第6个加号形相当于去掉四个角上的白色矩形，周长相同。因此共有 4 个图形的周长与方形纸本身相同。
